title: Chapter 281: Spider Sister
html:
The moment the investigator leaned backward, Chen Ge lunged forward. Yet the three meters between them might as well have been an uncrossable chasm.

He did not make it.

The night wind roared past the investigator’s ears as he plunged through the air, his face contorting during his final three seconds in this world. The distance between them widened. His lips moved, but the howling wind swallowed his voice. From their shape, Chen Ge could barely make out two words—Men Nan.

Chen Ge could not understand why the investigator would mention Men Nan in the final moment of his life. Perhaps he meant to confuse Chen Ge—or perhaps he was leaving a message.

“Yao Qinyi!” Lee Zheng’s furious shout erupted from the stairwell as several officers rushed to the edge.

A heavy impact rose from below. It was the first time Chen Ge had heard the sound of a life ending.

Yao Qinyi had landed headfirst. Even in death, his face remained turned toward the roof, amusement in his eyes and a malicious grin on his lips.

Half of Chen Ge’s body hung over the edge, his outstretched hands grasping nothing but air.

“The Ghost Stories Society…” The organization of mental patients and murderers had finally revealed its true face. Human life meant nothing to them.

“Chen Ge, what’s going on!” Lee Zheng demanded with red-rimmed eyes.

Chen Ge slowly drew back his arms. In a tightly controlled voice, he asked, “Who called you?”

“A nurse. A patient saw Uncle Yao leave his room in the middle of the night, apparently sleepwalking. Given what happened to Xiao Jia, we were afraid Uncle Yao might have an accident, so we rushed here from Fang Hwa Apartments.”

“A nurse called the police?” Chen Ge gripped the railing with both hands and stared down at the smile frozen on Yao Qinyi’s face.

Were his final words true or false? Who is the real person controlling these scapegoats—Wu Fei, the chairperson, or No. 10?

Only three Society members remained, but unless Chen Ge eliminated the chairperson, new members would soon replace the dead. Tragedy and despair occurred every day.

When pain accumulated in someone’s heart and gradually corrupted their soul, a flyer from the Ghost Stories Society would arrive.

I have to destroy the Ghost Stories Society before next Wednesday.With Zhang Ya dormant, confronting the final three members alone would be difficult.I need another Red Specter!

Police cars surrounded the People’s Hospital. Because Lee Zheng and several other officers had witnessed Yao Qinyi’s leap, they did not trouble Chen Ge. At around four in the morning, someone drove him back to New Century Park.

Chen Ge locked himself in the staff break room and placed the black phone on the table. Though he had to work that morning, he felt no fatigue. Sitting down, he reviewed the available missions.

Daily Missions offer rewards, but only Nightmare Missions improve my personal abilities. Since the requirements for triggering them changed, I haven’t encountered another one. Normal Missions focus on improving the Haunted House; I can complete those when I have time.

The black phone currently offers two Trial Missions: the Hearse, a two-star scenario, and the School of the Afterlife, a four-star scenario. Unlocking a scenario and completing its hidden mission could reward me with new ghost employees. Trial Missions strengthen the Haunted House, but a low-star mission won’t help me much, while a high-star mission is far too dangerous.

Chen Ge faced a dilemma. Only after Zhang Ya fell dormant did he realize that his previous fearlessness had depended entirely on the Red Specter who took such a special interest in him.

The screams collected from visitors over the last two days should be enough for two spins. The Wheel of Misfortune could increase my strength, but its results are far too unpredictable.

Remembering his previous draws, Chen Ge shook his head. He decided to wait until the following afternoon, when the sun was at its brightest.

The situation is urgent. If the ghost from the wheel isn’t compliant, I’ll have to feed them to Xu Yin.

Xu Yin had the potential to become a Red Specter, and only a Red Specter could pose a real threat to the Ghost Stories Society.

The Society has controlled its door for years. They must possess more than two Red Specters. They probably haven’t acted because they don’t know the limits of my strength. If they learned that Zhang Ya is dormant and cannot help me, they would seize the opportunity to eliminate me.

He glanced at his shadow. The silhouette of the long-haired woman still startled him.

Zhang Ya has probably considered that already.Chen Ge removed the wooden box from inside his coat and examined the doll closely. Why did Zhang Ya give this to me? Can it protect me in an emergency?

Carrying a doll fashioned from a man’s soul was profoundly unsettling.

The wooden box was cumbersome, so Chen Ge found a black plastic bag and dropped the doll inside.

He turned off the phone, lay on the bed, and slowly drifted off to sleep.

…

His alarm woke him at 8:30 a.m. Despite sleeping only three or four hours a night for the past several days, he felt no fatigue. The only change he noticed was that his body temperature seemed lower than usual, though it caused no obvious discomfort.

The park opened for the day at 8:55 a.m.

Xiao Gu remained in the hospital, but Captain Yan said he was stable and past the critical stage. He would probably be discharged within a few days.

Uncle Wong had fared worse. His age and the severe trauma left him ill with a persistent high fever. During a lucid interval, he told the police that he intended to resign from his security job. They questioned him about that night, but he could remember nothing.

The visitors rushed into the park, and the number was greater than yesterday.

With Xiao Gu absent, Chen Ge had to alternate between two scenarios. He did not get a break until lunch.

The Haunted House’s reputation continued to grow. Despite the heavier workload, Chen Ge felt satisfied. At 12:30 p.m., he sat on the front steps and counted the morning’s earnings. He was only halfway finished when his phone rang.

The number was unfamiliar. Too busy to deal with it, he nearly ignored the call, but ultimately answered.

A woman’s voice came through. “I’m sorry, are you Chen Ge?”

“Yes, I am.”

“Good afternoon. I’m calling from Jiujiang Children’s Home. Your name is listed as Fan Yu’s guardian. Since his aunt is currently incarcerated, we need you to come in and discuss a few matters.”

“Is it related to Fan Yu?” The boy who drew about ghosts had left a deep impression on Chen Ge.

“Yes. He has found himself an older sister here at the Children’s Home.”

“That’s a good thing; the boy doesn’t like to communicate with people. I’m glad that there have been positive changes…”

“But what if that sister isn’t human? What if she’s a spider?”

“A spider?”
